log: setup: every POST to LM Studio is caught (nothing really loads or unloads); the model list is read for real
js: (async () => { window.__fetch = window.__fetch || window.fetch; window.__calls = []; window.__fakeLoaded = false; window.fetch = async (u, o) => { const url = String(u); if (url.startsWith(LMS_URL) && o && o.method === 'POST') { const body = JSON.parse(o.body); window.__calls.push(url.replace(LMS_URL, '') + ' ' + JSON.stringify(body)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (url.endsWith('/api/v1/models/load')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ type: 'llm', instance_id: body.model, load_time_seconds: 4.2, status: 'loaded', load_config: { context_length: body.context_length, eval_batch_size: 512, flash_attention: body.flash_attention, offload_kv_cache_to_gpu: body.offload_kv_cache_to_gpu } }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); if (url.endsWith('/api/v1/models/unload')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ instance_id: body.instance_id }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); return new Response('{}', { status: 400 }); } const res = await window.__fetch(u, o); if (url === LMS_URL + '/api/v1/models' && window.__fakeLoaded) { const d = await res.json(); const c = d.models.find((x) => x.key === 'qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct'); if (c) c.loaded_instances = [{ id: 'qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct', config: { context_length: 4096 } }]; return new Response(JSON.stringify(d), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); } return res; }; await checkLms(); return 'LM Studio online: ' + state.lms.online + ', models: ' + state.lms.models.length; })()

log: real POST from the page (CORS) with a name that does not exist: LM Studio must answer 'not found', nothing loads
js: (async () => { const f = window.fetch; window.fetch = window.__fetch; try { await lmsPost('/api/v1/models/load', { model: 'tt-probe-does-not-exist', context_length: 8192 }); return 'UNEXPECTED: no error'; } catch (e) { return (e instanceof TypeError ? 'CORS/NETWORK FAIL: ' : 'OK, LM Studio answered: ') + e.message; } finally { window.fetch = f; } })()

(() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-lmsload]'); const card = document.querySelector('#detail .lmset'); return (b ? 'BUTTON: ' + b.textContent : 'NO BUTTON') + ' | ' + (card ? card.innerText.replace(/\n+/g, ' / ').slice(0, 500) : 'no card'); })()

log: click the button: the check window
js: (() => { document.querySelector('[data-lmsload]').click(); const d = document.getElementById('dlgLmsLoad'); return 'open: ' + d.open + ' | ' + d.innerText.replace(/\n+/g, ' / ').slice(0, 900) + ' | calls: ' + window.__calls.length; })()

(async () => { document.getElementById('btnLmsLoadGo').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const d = document.getElementById('dlgLmsLoad'); return 'phase: ' + state.lmsLoad.phase + ' | calls: ' + window.__calls.join(' || ') + ' | ' + d.innerText.replace(/\n+/g, ' / ').slice(0, 600); })()

log: case 2: the model is loaded already (faked) + other models loaded: unload first
js: (async () => { document.getElementById('dlgLmsLoad').close(); window.__calls = []; window.__fakeLoaded = true; await checkLms(); renderDetail(); document.querySelector('[data-lmsload]').click(); const d = document.getElementById('dlgLmsLoad'); return d.innerText.replace(/\n+/g, ' / ').slice(0, 1200); })()

log: tick 'unload the others' and press Load
js: (async () => { const cb = document.getElementById('lmsUnloadOthers'); if (cb) cb.checked = true; document.getElementById('btnLmsLoadGo').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return 'box: ' + !!cb + ' | phase: ' + state.lmsLoad.phase + ' | calls: ' + window.__calls.join(' || '); })()

log: case 3: LM Studio refuses (error shown, Try again)
js: (async () => { document.getElementById('dlgLmsLoad').close(); window.__fakeLoaded = false; const f = window.fetch; window.fetch = async (u, o) => (String(u).endsWith('/api/v1/models/load') ? new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'Not enough memory to load the model.' } }), { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }) : f(u, o)); await checkLms(); renderDetail(); document.querySelector('[data-lmsload]').click(); document.getElementById('btnLmsLoadGo').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); window.fetch = f; const d = document.getElementById('dlgLmsLoad'); return 'phase: ' + state.lmsLoad.phase + ' | button: ' + document.getElementById('btnLmsLoadGo').textContent + ' | ' + d.innerText.replace(/\n+/g, ' / ').slice(0, 700); })()
